definitions.explanation: Not precise or detailed; giving a general idea.
Not paying attention to details; lacking meticulousness.

examples.japanese: {大雑把|おおざっぱ}に{言|い}うと、{費用|ひよう}は{100万円|ひゃくまんえん}くらいです。
examples.english: Roughly speaking, the cost is about 1 million yen.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大雑把|おおざっぱ}な{性格|せいかく}だ。
{大雑把|おおざっぱ}な{計算|けいさん}でいいから、{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: A rough calculation is fine, so please tell me.

notes:
FORMS:
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}な + noun (adnominal)
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}に (adverbial) - "roughly"
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{大|おお} (big) + {雑把|ざっぱ} (rough grasp)

USAGE:
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}な{見積|みつも}もり (rough estimate)
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}な{説明|せつめい} (rough explanation)
・{大雑把|おおざっぱ}に{言|い}えば (roughly speaking)

ANTONYM:
・{几帳面|きちょうめん} - meticulous, precise
・{細|こま}かい - detailed, particular
